note: segullah means a personal treasure or private property. "Peculiar" meant "one's own" in 1611 but now means "odd".

kjv: There shall not an hand touch it
mine: No hand shall touch him (whoever touches the mountain)
note: bo can mean "it" (the mountain) or "him" (the trespasser). Since the offender is to be stoned or shot from a distance, it most likely means "him".

kjv: God answered him (Moses) by a voice
mine: God would answer him (Moses) in thunder
note: beqol can mean "with a voice" or "in thunder". qolot means thunder in v. 16.
